analysis: The only changed line in this file is at line 313 of EngineV2ProductionWiringTests.swift, a test helper (recordServerStream). It adds `.logprobs` to the case that `continue`s, which makes the switch exhaustive for a new MLXServerGenerationEvent case. The three supplied units (base lines 1221-2591) are unchanged test code around that edit, covering EngineV2 wiring, tool-choice validation, cancellation, KV-backend fallback heartbeat and prefill deadline tests. The change touches test code only and adds no production attack surface. It does not alter the encryption path, attestation, authorization, cache scope or cacheSalt plumbing. The tests continue to check the fail-closed behaviour in T-008 (no plaintext on failure), the cancellation propagation in T-010, and the cacheSalt tenant-scope plumbing relevant to T-041, but nothing in them changes. One question for integration: the new `.logprobs` event is ignored here by the test helper. The production source that emits it, and whether logprobs are encrypted per-chunk along with other response content, is outside this batch. That path is worth checking against T-008 and A-001 if the logprobs event was newly introduced in the same PR. Nothing in the supplied evidence shows a regression.
